statements.t: We are also excited to have dosed our first participant in the Phase 1 trial of HMB-003 in heavy menstrual bleeding, and look forward to sharing additional preclinical and clinical data from all three programs in the coming months.”
A replay of the webcast will be available on the company’s website approximately two hours after the call’s conclusion and will be available for approximately 90 days following the call.

the timing of and Hemab’s ability to initiate and enroll patients in clinical trials
